summary: Canadian National Railway Co. filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, reporting its first-quarter 2026 earnings and repurchased approximately 6 million shares for C$869 million. This is a routine earnings release with a share buyback under an existing program, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. The filing is a standard quarterly report with no transformative corporate action.
